findings.topic: WebSocket token fallback contradicts HttpOnly cookie boundary
findings.section: Wave 9 — W9 — Auth Enforce + Cookie Navigation + Ops Cutover (C2 gate)
findings.criterion: 2. One route table, declarative auth, default-deny.
findings.message: Wave 9 specifies that the `anchor_auth` cookie is `HttpOnly` (preventing JS access) yet allows a fallback to `?token=` on WebSocket/SSE connections. If the token is not exposed to JS, the client cannot construct the fallback URL; if the token is exposed to JS (e.g., via `window.ANCHOR_BOOT`), it defeats the security isolation of the `HttpOnly` cookie.

findings.topic: Manual operator intervention required to resolve crash-window divergence
findings.section: Wave 12 — journal.py Core: emit() Choke Point + Butler Envelope
findings.message: By requiring explicit operator action to replay/confirm unconfirmed intents rather than automatically reconciling them on startup (e.g., auto-confirming if the legacy write is verified to have succeeded), any crash in the legacy-to-confirm window leaves the journal permanently incomplete. If a rebuild occurs before manual operator intervention, the recovery tool will omit these writes, failing the 'recoverable-by-construction' guarantee.

findings.topic: Non-parent process monitoring limitations in Python stdlib on Windows
findings.section: Wave 15 — Supervisor Core: Inline Seam + IPC Contract + Restart Matrix
findings.message: Since the supervisor must run with 'Python stdlib only' and the restarted supervisor is not the OS-level parent of the surviving jobs, it cannot use standard parent-child signals or `subprocess` APIs. Monitoring non-child processes on Windows without third-party libraries requires complex `ctypes` bindings to open handles and poll exit codes. If a job terminates while the supervisor is restarting, the exit code cannot be retrieved, violating clean job status tracking.

findings.topic: Ephemeral boot secret invalidates active sessions on restart
findings.section: Wave 9 — W9 — Auth Enforce + Cookie Navigation + Ops Cutover (C2 gate)
findings.message: Since the `boot_secret` is minted per server start, any dashboard restart (including the supervisor restart demo or daily service cycles) invalidates all active browser and PWA cookies. Because cookieless/tokenless page hits return a hard 401 error page instead of delegating to a local token-read or auto-refresh handshake, John's existing open tabs will break and require manual relaunch from desktop files, disrupting daily use.
